title: noema-lite language package (docs/LANGUAGES.md §10.2)
description: ONE language for ONE language course, as one file: made by `tools/lang_course.py package <course-folder> <code>` (refused while validate_lang.py --strict --lang <code> has errors), checked by langcore.checkLangPackage (the app and the connector) and added to the course by langcore.langApplyPackage. A package fills the course's existing nodes and functions; it never adds a node, a concept, a function or a frame. The parts use the definitions of noema.lang.v1.

course.description: the course id (a library course or the learner's account course)

code.description: ISO 639 code of the language; new to the course

name.description: the language's name in English (e.g. Persian)

flag.description: an emoji flag shown with the language (optional)

built.description: ISO time the package was made

lexicon.description: node id → lang/<code>/lexicon/<node>.json (only nodes of the course)

grammar.description: function id → lang/<code>/grammar/<fn>.json (only functions of the course)

fieldExemptions.description: D19: the bank's fieldExemptions ({field, function, reason}) — a field that cannot show a node says why

script.description: lang/<code>/script.json (§4.9), when the language has one

chars.description: lang/<code>/chars.json (§4.9), when the language has one

typology.description: the language's entry for library/languages/_typology/languages.json — only when the library has no profile for it (D16)

seeAlso.description: additions to the other course languages' grammar pages: language code → function id → [seeAlso entries pointing to the new language]
